messages:
tess: Alert - were seeing ~11% fncall schema rejects for a single customer flow since validator v2.3 roll. Theyre sending an array where schema expects an object (rows -> object).

sam: Oof. Is this the strict validator change we shipped this morning?

tess: Yes. Example payload: {"tool":"search","tool_response":{"rows":[{"id":"a","score":0.9}]}}

chris: Current behavior routes to degen which surfaces a 503. Customer hit frontend error. We should avoid billing surprises and give Support samples.

jo: Proposal: add a soft-validate rollout option. If validator fails with a coercible code (ARR_OBJ, SINGLETON_ARRAY) then route to fallback, tag invocation with validation_status=warn and billing_mode=free_fallback, emit metric fncall.validation_outcome{status,code,validator}. Store hashed sample_id and keep full sample in audit logs 7d.

sam: Implementation plan: I can add metric labels + billing flag in rev-router and a small heuristic classifier in validator. Hotfix for 1&2 today, UI work later.

chris: Alerts: page on fail>1% or warn+fallback_latency > 2x. Sampling: 100% fails, 1% warns. Also add a Console column for validation_code and a link to sample.

tess: Agreed. Quick mitigation: mark this tenant permissive in routing until hotfix lands.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by sam for rev-router@hotfix -> env=prod shard=us-west-2

sam: PR: https://git.internal/rev-router/pull/501 - adds validation_outcome metric and billing_mode flag. Tests included.
